rule: One role, one proof reason, one money rule, and one next action stay visible before deeper workflow power.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, escrow, booking commission, supplier payout, or rental custody belongs in the action bar.

roles.proof_reason: Trust, availability, and proof count are visible before the buyer moves deeper.
Listing revenue, proof status, and freshness decide the supplier next action.
roles.money_rule: USD 9 monthly or USD 99 yearly per active listing

roles.proof_reason: Demand, supply gap, trust, and listing ARR decide the next wedge.
roles.money_rule: Scale listing SaaS before any future success fee

acceptance: Simplicity Bar is followed by Calm Action Bar.
Buyer sees one direct enquiry action.
Supplier sees one listing, proof, freshness, or revenue action.
Founder sees one market command action.
Build Phase documents v143 before the Release Ledger.
